description.en: Harness-layer jailbreak and red-team evaluation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt injection, patch presets, drill console.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的宿主层破甲 / 红队评测插件：提示词注入、补丁预设、演练台。

title.zh: dsh-purge · 破甲 / 红队评测

description.en: Rewrites the host layer at runtime — system prompt, patch presets, approval gates, session rewind — plus a drill console with presets, skills and a SQLite fact store. Requires dsh >= 0.2.2 and Node >= 22.5.
description.zh: 运行时改写宿主层：系统提示词、补丁预设、审批闸门、会话回退，另带演练台（预设 + 技能 + SQLite 事实库）。要求 dsh >= 0.2.2、Node >= 22.5。
